1.texto_original: ¶ Aku terus weruh rerupa sing élok lan nggumunké. Enèng mulékat pitu pada nggawa memala pitu sing kèri. Iki setrapané Gusti Allah sing kèri déwé.
1.normal:
Devotional Study of Pamedaran 15:1

"¶ Aku terus weruh rerupa sing élok lan nggumunké. Enèng mulékat pitu pada nggawa memala pitu sing kèri. Iki setrapané Gusti Allah sing kèri déwé."

This verse carries deep theological significance. The original Hebrew/Greek text reveals layers of meaning that illuminate Gods character and purposes. The context within the broader narrative provides essential framework for understanding.

The historical backdrop adds richness to interpretation. Archaeological discoveries continue to confirm and illuminate the cultural setting in which these words were written.

For the modern reader, this verse offers both comfort and challenge. It invites us to trust in Gods sovereign plan while actively living out its principles in daily life.

2.texto_original: ¶ Aku terus weruh rerupa kétoké kaya segara katya tyampur karo geni. Aku uga weruh wong-wong sing wis pada menang enggoné perang karo kéwan lan retyané lan menangké wong sing jenengé digambarké nganggo nomer. Wong-wong sing wis pada menang kuwi pada ngadek nang pinggiré segara katya mau. Pada nyekel tylempung sing dikèki Gusti Allah.
